note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Jordan: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Taxable income is taxed at 5% on the first JOD 5,000, then 10%, 15% and 20% on each next 5,000, 25% to JOD 1 million and 30% above, plus a 1% national contribution on income over JOD 200,000; a taxpayer deducts a personal exemption of JOD 9,000 (a breadwinner another 9,000 for dependants) plus up to JOD 1,000 each for documented medical, education, rent and housing-loan costs, to at most JOD 23,000 for a family.

allowance.expenses: 1,000 each for taxpayer, spouse and up to three children

figures.applies: Income Tax Law No. 38 of 2018 (in force from 2019); Jordan taxes income arising in or from Jordan

sources.said: Taxable income (JOD*) PIT rate (%) The first 5,000 5 The second 5,000 10 The third 5,000 15 The forth 5,000 20 Over 20,000 and up to 1,000,000 25 The remaining balance 30
Any amount exceeding JOD 200,000 of the annual taxable income for individuals will be subject to 1% as national contribution tax.

the total exemptions to which the breadwinner is entitled to the income earned during the year 2021 is (23) thousand dinars, including the personal exemption at the rate of (9) thousand dinars and (9) thousand dinars as a dependency allowance

With regard to the taxpayer who is not a breadwinner , the law granted him 9 thousand dinars as a personal exemption in addition to a thousand dinars in exchange for expenses related to treatment, education, rent, housing loan interest and Murabaha.
Any income incurred in or from Jordan, for any person, regardless of the place of payment, shall be subject to tax in Jordan.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the return and the tax are due before the end of the fourth month after it (30 April).

sources.said: The tax year in Jordan is the calendar year.
Taxpayers are obligated to file tax returns before the end of the fourth month following the end of the tax period.

figures.finding: Social security takes 7.5% of salary from the employee and 14.25% from the employer, on monthly salary up to JOD 3,394 (2023 figure).

sources.said: The social security rates are 14.25% as employer contribution and 7.5% as employee contribution.
The maximum monthly salary subject to social security contributions is JOD 3,394.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax from monthly pay at the progressive rates; payers withhold 5% from fees for services of resident individuals (professionals, consultants and the like).

sources.said: Individual income tax is withheld by the employer from an employee’s monthly compensation at progressive rates ranging from 5% to 30%.

A 5% WHT applies to services provided by resident natural persons or civil companies, including doctors, lawyers, engineers, auditors, consultants, insurance agents, brokers, arbitrators, financial intermediaries, and shipping agents.

figures.finding: A non-resident's Jordanian-source income is taxed; services and royalties paid to a non-resident individual bear 10% withholding plus a 1% national contribution; whether it is final for an individual's performance fee was not confirmed.

sources.said: Royalties: The rate of withholding tax on royalties paid to a nonresident company or individual is 10% (plus an additional national contribution tax).
10% (plus national contribution tax at sector rate) 10% (plus 1% national contribution tax)

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a resident are withheld at the recipient's income tax rate, and to a non-resident at 10% plus 1%; no special regime for authors was found.

sources.said: Tax is withheld from royalties paid to a resident at the company’s or individual’s income tax rate.

figures.finding: General sales tax (Jordan's VAT) is 16% on goods and services; a business must register once annual taxable turnover exceeds JOD 30,000.

sources.said: A general sales tax similar in operation to a value-added tax (VAT) is imposed at the rate of 16% on the following transactions: Sales of goods or services or both.
Registration: Businesses with annual taxable turnover of more than JOD 30,000 must register for sales tax purposes.

figures.finding: The highest wage on which social security contributions are computed is JOD 3,733 for 2026 (JOD 3,668 in 2025), indexed each year to the previous year's inflation (1.77% in 2025).
figures.applies: 2026, insured persons under the Social Security Law; the employee 7.5% and employer 14.25% shares are in the figure above.

sources.said: أن الحد الأعلى للأجر الذي تُحتسب اشتراكات الضمان على أساسه للعام الحالي 2026 أصبح (3733) ديناراً، في حين كان العام الماضي (3668) ديناراً … كلاهما مرتبطٌ بنسبة التضخُّم، حيث تُؤخذ هذه النسبة المسجَّلة في المملكة عن السنة السابقة، والتي بلغت (1.77%) في عام 2025

figures.finding: A non-resident's fee for a service is taxable income in Jordan where the work is done in Jordan or its output is used there, so a visiting performer's, writer's or director's fee for work in Jordan falls in the tax.
figures.applies: Income Tax Law as published by ISTD; the withholding rate and finality are in the PwC figure above and the blocker.
